prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity desktop web application design study for TanStack Coding Starter, an elegant compact coding agent workspace, edge to edge, no device frame. Show three panes: narrow sessions sidebar, dominant central conversation with real coding tool activity, narrow file preview. Main content: user asks 'Handle blank names in greet.js'; assistant says 'I’ll check the implementation and its tests.' Then a quiet 'Read greet.js' activity row and expanded file text, a 'Run tests' row with npm test and failed output, and a patch preview changing return name to return name.trim() with subdued red/green lines and a clear Allow once / Reject decision footer. A compact composer anchors the bottom. Choose a clean minimalist approach inspired by contemporary Claude and Linear. Manrope sans-serif interface and IBM Plex Mono code. Soft white and warm graphite neutrals, muted moss-green accent. No colored left accent borders, no nested cards, no decorative gradients. Hierarchy through typography, alignment and proximity. Use only essential separators, small lucid icons, airy within code but compact overall. Show a settings popover with eight softly warm vintage rainbow color circles. Prioritize beautiful detailed tool rendering, exact command readability, coherent restrained chrome. This is a design concept with illustrative code, not a screenshot of a real execution.
purpose: Design study; implementation choice delegated by the user
